project: Computer Wisdom / CoinBaseKid / Classes with Glasses
scope: Evidence catalog only. No account recovery, no wallet custody, no login, no payment, no GitHub write rights.
audit_rule: New claims must reference dated source evidence and preserve older assertions; an unresolved claim stays OPEN, a HOLD stays HOLD until explicitly approved.

append_only.design_intent: Append dated, source-anchored claims instead of rewriting history

layers.title: The penny: Base USDC self-transfer
layers.why: The user supplied BaseScan receipt: 0.01 USDC sent from jaywisdom.base.eth to itself via one account-abstraction UserOp. Explorer receipt has not been independently rechecked in this index.

layers.title: Basename controller binding: still unsigned
layers.why: Repository V2 prepared binding links jaywisdom.base.eth with controller 0xA380... but explicitly says SHOW_WALLET_PROOF=PENDING and PREPARED_NOT_SIGNED.

layers.title: Original desktop EIP-712 v2 wallet-control tests
layers.why: Merged PR #719 pins Base 8453, origin, domain name/version/salt and the separate desktop signer. This does not authorize the @jaywisdom controller account.

layers.title: §4 Replay ledger and signature ordering
layers.why: Merged PR #720 verified cryptographic-before-DB ordering, nonce replay rejection and atomic SQLite writes. Single-host ledger; no cross-instance protection.

layers.title: §5a Independent witness candidate
layers.why: Merged PR #721: distinct synthetic witness role; zero real-world witness identities enrolled; created block provenance OPEN.

layers.title: §5b Recipient-only encrypted export candidate
layers.why: Merged PR #722 tested X25519/AES-GCM encryption and wrong-key failure. No real export authority, recipient-key identity chain or HTTP export.

layers.title: REPLAY 008: operational trust policies
layers.why: Merged PR #723 documents proposed finality and DID binding policy, but no approver, verified trust roots or recipient enrollment.

layers.title: Wallet-control story: local proof only
layers.why: This page creates a fresh Base-domain signature in your wallet and checks EOA recovery or deployed ERC-1271. It never uploads signatures or changes GitHub access; verification is only on this device.

layers.title: x402 checkout, settlement and iPhone authorization
layers.why: G2–G7 and the payment/checkout specification remain unverified and unapproved. A wallet-control signature cannot authorize a charge.
